evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Performed declarative ratifying a settled switch; 'we're switching' is operational commitment language, not a position being argued.
Flat unhedged assertion offered as justification — ready to defend but moveable with evidence; no ratification or operational language.
Arrow notation records the migration as a settled, load-bearing transition — a performed ratification of the switch, not a proposal.
Unhedged performance assertion presented as fact but without ratification or operational commitment language — a claim ready to defend.
Fixed timeline attached to the migration is an operational commitment — pinning a quarter makes the decision load-bearing and actionable.
